convention: T_reference_TCP maps points from the TCP frame into the reference-tag (ID 2) frame: p_ref = T_reference_TCP @ p_tcp.
tcp_definition: Fingertip-pad midpoint from STEP geometry. Marker frame convention: +Z is the outward face normal, sticker 'up' is assembly +Z, +X points right. Validate the projected TCP axes on a static RGB frame before use.
